def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])
    node_map = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
    children = {n['id']: [] for n in nodes}
    root_id = None
    for n in nodes:
        if n['parent'] is None:
            root_id = n['id']
        else:
            children.setdefault(n['parent'], []).append(n['id'])
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    removal_order = []
    for n in sorted_nodes:
        nid = n['id']
        if nid == root_id:
            continue
        if not n['removable']:
            continue
        if n['symbol'] in required_symbols:
            continue
        has_retained_child = any(child in retained for child in children.get(nid, []))
        if has_retained_child:
            continue
        temp_retained = retained - {nid}
        all_required_present = True
        for sym in required_symbols:
            if not any(node_map[nid2]['symbol'] == sym for nid2 in temp_retained):
                all_required_present = False
                break
        if not all_required_present:
            continue
        removal_order.append(nid)
        retained = temp_retained
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {
        'removed_node_ids': removal_order,
        'retained_node_ids': retained_sorted
    }
